e: Borrowed from Italian orzo (“barley”), from Latin hordeum, ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *ǵʰr̥sdeyom (“bristly”). Doublet of orgeat and horchata.
q: Apart from the classic side dishes, it offers dozens more, among them herbed orzo, baked black beans with sour cream, broccoli puree with creme fraiche; […]
